apps/web/vercel.json.description: Vercel configuration file at apps/web/vercel.json. Currently only has cache headers for /assets/* path. Application uses external resources: Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com), Vercel Analytics (*.vercel-scripts.com, *.vercel-insights.com), Sentry (*.sentry.io), Supabase (*.supabase.co). Also uses blob: URLs for html-to-image generation feature.
